The Recipe

No fillers, no artificial flavors, no numbers-as-ingredients. Just whole foods doing what they do.

The Origin

Our
Story

Two Founders. One Mom. One Son. One Kitchen.

ProTEEN Bites started with a conversation between a mom and her son. As a teenager and athlete, Marcos wanted more protein in his diet, but we struggled to find snacks that were both made with ingredients we felt good about and actually tasted great. So, instead of settling, we decided to make our own.

We went into the kitchen and started experimenting — dates, peanut butter, chia seeds, protein powder, dark chocolate, and a few other simple ingredients. There were plenty of failed batches and plenty of honest feedback. But eventually we made a batch Marcos finished in one sitting, then asked, “When are we making more?” That’s when we knew we had something.

What began as a mom-and-son kitchen experiment became ProTEEN Bites, founded together by the two of us right here in New York City. Marcos brings the perspective of a teenager and athlete — what young people actually want in a snack — while Mom brings the passion for creating food with simple, thoughtfully chosen ingredients.

Sonia & Marcos, Founders
